<?php

namespace App\Marvin\Functions\Prodcat;

use App\Models\Prodcat;
use App\Models\ProdcatLang;
use AtrioTeam\Marvin\App\Functions\Base;
use AtrioTeam\Marvin\App\Functions\Base\ControllerInterface;
use AtrioTeam\Marvin\App\Functions\Base\HandlerInputSaveInterface;
use AtrioTeam\Marvin\App\Functions\Base\ViewInterface;
use AtrioTeam\Marvin\App\Rules\CleanString;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class Controller extends Base\Controller implements ControllerInterface
{
    /**
     * Modello Eloquent gestito dal controller.
     * Serve per metodi ereditati dal controller base
     */
    protected function model(): string
    {
        return Prodcat::class;
    }


    /**
     * Lista
     */
    public function list(Request $request, ViewInterface $FunctionView)
    {


        /**
         * Recupero voci
         */
        $data['result'] = $this->model()::bylang(1)->where(DB::raw('COALESCE(parent_id, 0)'), 0)->orderBy("position")->get();

        /**
         * Imposta data su view
         */
        $FunctionView->setData($data);

        return view("marvin::functions.default.list", [
            "view" => $FunctionView
        ]);
    }


    /**
     * Input (insert e update)
     */
    public function input(Request $request, ViewInterface $FunctionView)
    {

        $data = [
            "saveEnabled" => true
        ];

        /**
         * Recupero voce
         */
        $data["item"] = $this->makeItem($request);

        /**
         * Imposta data su view
         */
        $FunctionView->setData($data);


        /**
         * Risposta
         */
        return view($this->config['function_code'] . "::input_form", [
            "view" => $FunctionView,
            "item" => $data["item"],
            "saveEnabled" => true,
        ]);
    }


    /**
     * Salvataggio
     */
    public function inputsave(Request $request, HandlerInputSaveInterface $Handler)
    {


        /**
         * campi per raccolta dati e validazione
         */
        $fields = [
            "color_1" => ["rules" => ["nullable", 'string'], "label" => "Colore 1"],
            "color_2" => ["rules" => ["nullable", 'string'], "label" => "Colore 2"],
            'onpage_resource' => ['rules' => ['required', 'string'], 'label' => 'OnPage - Nome risorsa'],
            'onpage_id' => ['rules' => ['required', 'string', 'numeric'], 'label' => 'OnPage - ID risorsa'],
        ];
        $langFields = [
            "title" => ["rules" => ["required", new CleanString()], "label" => "Titolo"],
            "alternative_title" => ["rules" => ["nullable", new CleanString()], "label" => "Titolo alternativo"],
            "subtitle" => ["rules" => ["nullable", new CleanString()], "label" => "Sottotitolo"],
            "home_description" => ["rules" => ["nullable", new CleanString()], "label" => "Descrizione homepage"],
            "home_marquee" => ["rules" => ["nullable", new CleanString()], "label" => "Testo marquee homepage"],
            "description" => ["rules" => ["nullable"], "label" => "Testo"],
            "page_url" => ["rules" => ["required"], "label" => "Url"],
            "page_title" => ["rules" => ["required"], "label" => "Title"],
            "page_description" => ["rules" => ["nullable"], "label" => "Description"],
            "focus_keyword" => ["rules" => ["nullable"], "label" => "Focus keyword"],
        ];


        /**
         * modello
         */
        if ($request->id) {
            $item = $this->model()::findOrFail($request->id);
        } else {
            $item = (new \ReflectionClass($this->model()))->newInstance();
        }


        /**
         * validazione (risponde con errori se validazione fallisce).
         */
        $Handler->validate($request, (new \ReflectionClass($this->model() . 'Lang'))->newInstance(), $fields, $langFields, $request->id, function ($validator) {
            // validazione extra qui
        });


        /**
         * Salvataggio.
         * I modelli vengono mappati da Handler, aggiungere/modificarli
         * prima del salvataggio, se necessario
         */
        $Handler->mapModel($request, $fields, $item);

        $item->save();

        foreach ($this->langs as $lgId => $lang) {

            // check esistenza modello in lingua
            $modelLang = $item->langs()->where("lang", $lgId)->first() ?: new ProdcatLang();

            $Handler->mapModelLang($request, $langFields, $lgId, $modelLang);

            $item->langs()->save($modelLang);
        }


        /**
         * Salvataggio allegati
         */
        $Handler->saveAttachments($request, $item, $this->config, "prodcat");


        /**
         * Risposta
         */
        return response()->json([
            "data" => $item->id,
            "msg" => "Salvataggio eseguito",
            "redirect" => $this->UrlManager->functionUrlFromCode("prodcat", "list")
        ]);
    }


    public function order(Request $request, ViewInterface $FunctionView)
    {

        $data['result'] = $this->model()::byLang(1)->where(DB::raw('COALESCE(parent_id, 0)'), 0)->orderBy("position")->get();

        $FunctionView->setData($data);

        return view("marvin::functions.default.order", [
            "view" => $FunctionView,
        ]);
    }
}

Sottotitolo

` esce come `Sottotitolo` nudo. Non è specifico dei campi nuovi: quella whitelist è globale, quindi il pulsante è rotto in silenzio in **ogni** editor del backoffice (anche "Descrizione" di prodotti, news, ecc.).
